from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
from hashlib import sha256
import json, re

base = 'https://digitalmainstreet.ca/'
root = Path('products/distribution')
source = root / 'canadian-catalogue-partner/raw/digital-main-street-home.html'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '5f2f224aed6497ed7d499a5cccbc496ca66930442f96de977e298538c5b32b88'
terms = re.compile(r'resource|partner|contribut|submit|education|e.?commerce|catalogu|editorial|guideline|privacy|terms', re.I)

class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.href = None
        self.parts = []
        self.links = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.parts = []

    def handle_data(self, text):
        if self.href is not None:
            self.parts.append(text)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or self.href is None:
            return
        url = urljoin(base, self.href)
        label = ' '.join(' '.join(self.parts).split())
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        if parts.scheme == 'https' and parts.hostname in {'digitalmainstreet.ca', 'www.digitalmainstreet.ca'} and terms.search(label + ' ' + parts.path):
            item = {'label': label, 'url': url}
            if item not in self.links:
                self.links.append(item)
        self.href = None

parser = Links()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
prior = []
for name in ('accountless-route/bounded-rejection.json', 'existing-audience-referral/bounded-result.json'):
    evidence = (root / name).read_bytes()
    prior.append({'path': str(root / name), 'sha256': sha256(evidence).hexdigest(), 'mentions_digital_main_street': bool(re.search(rb'digital\s*main\s*street|digitalmainstreet\.ca', evidence, re.I))})
result = {'source': base, 'source_receipt': 'TASK-179496901500', 'source_sha256': digest, 'prior_text_overlap_checks': prior, 'official_links_to_assess': parser.links, 'scope': 'Navigation and overlap evidence only. Review relevant page text and prior handoffs before deciding whether a submission invitation, eligibility or authorization is established.'}
output = root / 'canadian-catalogue-partner/homepage-link-evidence.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
